title: Global Billing, Pricing & Checkout Experience 10/10 Overhaul (INR ₹ Harmonization, Dual-Gateway Resilience, GST Invoice Ledger & Cuba Executive Glassmorphism)
spec:
# DIR-018: Global Billing, Pricing & Checkout Experience 10/10 Overhaul

## 1. Executive Context & Objectives
The subscription, pricing, and checkout funnel (`src/components/Billing/Plans/Plans.jsx`, `Checkout.jsx`, `PlansTable.jsx`, and `src/components/Dashboard/DashboardSettings/SubscriptionModal.jsx`) is the core revenue engine of the platform.
Currently, `Plans.jsx` (79KB) and `Checkout.jsx` (189KB) still contain over 300 legacy Tailwind utilities, inconsistent currency formatting between INR (₹) and USD ($), lack Cuba Executive dark mode harmonization, and need a unified 10/10 executive presentation.

This directive mandates a complete 10/10 overhaul of the billing, plans, and checkout surfaces into a Google Cloud / Cuba Executive experience with seamless INR/USD currency harmonization, dual-gateway resilience (Razorpay + Stripe), transparent GST/tax breakdown, and dedicated Playwright E2E verification.

## 2. Key Architecture Directives
1. **Google Cloud / Cuba M3 Executive Pricing Matrix**:
   - Redesign `Plans.jsx` into 3 stunning elevated cards:
     - **Starter / Free**: Essential resume templates, basic AI suggestions.
     - **Pro / Career Accelerator (Most Popular)**: All 51 templates, unlimited AI tailoring, ATS match meter, audio interview coach, digital portfolio.
     - **Enterprise / Executive VIP**: Priority AI inference, recruiter direct outreach, dedicated domain hosting for Web CV.
   - Smooth animated monthly vs annual billing toggle with 'Save 20%' savings indicator.
   - Comprehensive feature comparison matrix (`PlansTable.jsx`) with tooltips explaining features.

2. **INR (₹) Base Currency & Dynamic FX Harmonization**:
   - Standardize base pricing in Indian Rupees (INR ₹) across all UI cards, in-modal displays, and checkouts, while respecting the active currency setting configured in MariaDB.
   - Formatter helper ensuring proper Indian numeral grouping (e.g. ₹1,499 / ₹14,999) with decimal precision.

3. **Streamlined Checkout Experience & Dual-Gateway Architecture**:
   - `Checkout.jsx`: Elevate to a focused, distraction-free 2-column checkout card:
     - Left: Selected plan details, billing cycle, coupon code input with instant validation, and itemized subtotal + GST (18%) tax breakdown.
     - Right: Payment gateway selection (Razorpay for UPI, NetBanking, RuPay/Cards; Stripe for International Cards) and secure checkout trigger.
   - Handle payment failure, network retry, and success confirmation modal with instant entitlement grant without full page reload.

4. **Dedicated Playwright E2E Verification**:
   - Author `playwright.dir018.config.js` targeting `tests/e2e/dir018-billing-checkout.spec.js`.
   - Test plan selection, billing cycle toggles, coupon input interaction, tax calculation display, and modal triggers against the live stack with zero mocks.
invariants: INV-1: Frozen Baseline Integrity: git diff e314f715 -- src/cv-templates/ backend/services/aiRuntime.js must remain STRICTLY 0 bytes (57 CV templates + AI runtime frozen).

INV-2: Zero Financial Credential Leakage: Secret keys (Razorpay Key Secret, Stripe Secret Key) must NEVER be exposed in client bundles or DOM; only public key IDs (rzp_live/rzp_test, pk_live/pk_test) are allowed on the client.
INV-3: Cryptographic Signature & Webhook Verification: All subscription creations and payments must be validated server-side using HMAC-SHA256 signatures before provisioning entitlements in MariaDB.
INV-4: Authentic MariaDB Grounding: All plan definitions, quotas, and invoice transactions must be read from and written to authoritative MariaDB tables with zero mock arrays.
INV-5: Performance Budget: Sub-100ms render budget; production bundle build duration < 4.0s.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-1: Purge All Legacy Styling in Billing: Completely eliminate legacy Tailwind classes from Plans.jsx, Checkout.jsx, and PlansTable.jsx, adopting Cuba Executive design tokens (--cuba-canvas, --cuba-card, --cuba-elevated, --cuba-line, --cuba-ink, --cuba-ink-muted, .cuba-btn-primary, .cuba-btn-outline).

AC-2: Google Cloud-Inspired 3-Tier Executive Pricing Cards: Redesign plan comparison into elevated Cuba glassmorphic cards (Free / Basic, Pro / Premium, Enterprise VIP) with animated badge highlights, monthly/annual billing cycle toggle (with 'Save 20%' pill), and feature matrix checklist.

AC-3: INR ₹ Base Currency Harmonization: Ensure base currency displays properly formatted INR (₹) symbol by default, with dynamic multi-currency support (USD $, EUR €, GBP £) derived from backend subscriptions config.
AC-4: Dynamic GST & Tax Breakdown: Checkout view must display itemized subtotal, 18% GST / sales tax breakdown, coupon discount deduction, and clear final settlement amount.
AC-5: Dual-Gateway Checkout Resilience: Seamlessly support Razorpay checkout modal for domestic INR transactions and Stripe Elements for international USD transactions, with clear fallback handling.
AC-6: Invoice History & PDF Receipts: In candidate dashboard/billing, render historical orders/invoices table with download receipt trigger communicating with authoritative MariaDB orders table.

AC-7: Dedicated Playwright E2E Suite (playwright.dir018.config.js & tests/e2e/dir018-billing-checkout.spec.js): 100% passing tests against live dev server verifying plan selection, monthly/annual toggle, checkout modal opening, coupon code entry, and zero DOM contrast breaches.
AC-8: Quality Gates Pass: vite build < 4.0s, eslint 0 errors, npm test zero regressions.

plan.summary: DIR-018 REBASELINE: audit shows the directive's root-cause premise is outdated. 5 of 8 ACs are already substantially implemented against authoritative MariaDB. Plan reframes DIR-018 from a greenfield rewrite into (A) 1 confirmed revenue-path correctness fix, (B) Cuba tokenization of 4 surfaces, (C) new Playwright suite. Explicitly NOT rebuilding: dual-gateway, coupon, invoice ledger, INR config all exist and are HMAC-verified.

adopt existing src/utils/gstUtils.js calculateGSTBreakdown (CGST/SGST/IGST split) as single shared source

4. AC-1 tokenization: purge ~628 legacy Tailwind utilities (Plans 141, Checkout 405, SubscriptionModal 82) and 2 hardcoded-hex blocks (Checkout.jsx:979-981, 1889-1891) onto --cuba-* tokens and cuba-btn-primary/outline
5. AC-2/AC-6 presentational only, data stays MariaDB-driven
retire orphan PlansTable.jsx (zero importers, hardcodes en-US grouping) or convert per Lead ruling
6. AC-7 author playwright.dir018.config.js + tests/e2e/dir018-billing-checkout.spec.js mirroring the dir017 live-server pattern
7. AC-8 gates: vite build <4.0s, eslint 0 errors, npm test zero regressions, INV-1 diff re-proven 0 bytes
